U.note: Seeded 32x32 world with house, tree and pond, beveled blocks, ten-block palette, undo and saved state; sky is plain dark and swatches carry no names.

V.note: Works with erase, grid and generate buttons, but opens to a blank dark grid with flat tiles, an unlabeled toolbar and a hint that does not mention the Grid and Generate buttons.

W.note: Clean, accessible Block Box with counts, flash feedback, status messages and an 8-cell guide grid, though it has only four block kinds and starts empty.

X.note: Starts with a ground layer and adds pick and fill tools with ten blocks, but the swatches are unfocusable divs with no names, the status line is cluttered, and undo records empty actions.

Y.note: Most game-like: textured blocks over a sky with clouds, generated terrain with trees and water, line-interpolated drags, new-world and undo, and it fits desktop and phone well.

Z.note: Polished and responsive with hi-DPI canvas, a two-step clear, pop animation and well-labeled kinds, but it opens empty with only four kinds.
